content.title: Webapp: Build the agentrack web UI

content.content:
Webapp initiative plan. Specs at .agentic/specs/webapp-spec.md and .agentic/specs/webapp-roadmap.md. 10 issues in 5 phases, each with implementation (webapp-developer) and validation (webapp-validator). Dependencies: Phase 1 → Phase 2 → Phase 3 → Phase 4 → Phase 5 (sequential, each phase gated by validation of previous phase). Issue tree:

Phase 1: Foundation (mppqqte6gs → mppqqzxmme)
Phase 2: Core issues (mppqrbsqix → mppqrqcu3u)
Phase 3: Rich detail (mppqs2gcqg → mppqsibq9f)
Phase 4: Users & sync (mppqswn3jl → mppqt90kot)
Phase 5: Polish (mppqtp1q9g → mppqtyr8ho)

Status-loop audit: this epic has been in-progress since 2026-05-28 with all direct children done (Isolated E2E data, Phase 4 Users & sync, Phase 4 Validation). The original Phase 1-5 issue IDs from the plan comment no longer exist. The webapp is built and actively tested — new webapp bugs/chores are tracked under separate epics (mqdzlo4ia8). Work is complete; marking done.
